date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  stages: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Pipeline summary

```{r summary}
cat(sprintf("Stages run: %s.\n",
            paste(names(params$stages), collapse = ", ")))
```

## Audit trail

```{r audit}
flag_tables <- lapply(names(params$stages), function(nm) {
  f <- params$stages[[nm]]$flags
  if (is.null(f) || !is.data.frame(f) || nrow(f) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (!"stage" %in% colnames(f)) f$stage <- nm
  f
})
flag_tables <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x), flag_tables)
if (length(flag_tables) > 0) {
  all_flags <- do.call(rbind, flag_tables)
  knitr::kable(all_flags)
} else {
  cat("No issues flagged at any stage.")
}
```

## Stage results

```{r stages}
for (nm in names(params$stages)) {
  cat("\n\n###", nm, "\n\n")
  print(params$stages[[nm]])
}
```
